coin: noun. A piece of currency, usually metallic and in the shape of a disc, but sometimes polygonal, or with a hole in the middle.
con: verb. To study or examine carefully, especially in order to gain knowledge of; to learn, or learn by heart.
cone: noun. A surface of revolution formed by rotating a segment of a line around another line that intersects the first line.
conn: noun. The duty of directing a ship, usually used with the verb to have or to take and accompanied by the article "the."
connive: verb. To secretly cooperate with other people in order to commit a crime or other wrongdoing; to collude, to conspire.
convince: verb. To make someone believe, or feel sure about something, especially by using logic, argument or evidence.
cove: noun. A hollow in a rock; a cave or cavern.
envoi: noun. A short stanza at the end of a poem, used either to address a person or to comment on the preceding body of the poem.
eon: noun. Eternity, the duration of the universe.
icon: noun. An image, symbol, picture, portrait, or other representation, usually as an object of religious devotion.
inn: noun. Any establishment where travellers can procure lodging, food, and drink.
ion: noun. An atom or group of atoms bearing an electrical charge, such as the sodium and chlorine atoms in a salt solution.
neon: noun. The chemical element (symbol Ne) with an atomic number of 10.
nine: numeral. A numerical value equal to 9; the number following eight and preceding ten.
nonce: noun. The one or single occasion; the present reason or purpose.
none: pronoun. Not any of a given number or group.
novice: noun. A beginner; one who is not very familiar or experienced in a particular subject.
once: adverb. One and only one time.
one: numeral. The number represented by the Arabic numeral 1; the numerical value equal to that cardinal number.
oven: noun. A chamber used for baking or heating.
ovine: adjective. Of, being, pertaining to, or resembling a sheep; also, of an animal: from the genus Ovis.
vein: noun. A blood vessel that transports blood from the capillaries back to the heart.
vice: noun. Bad or immoral behaviour. (Especially often, a habit that harms oneself or others)
vie: verb. To fight for superiority; to contend; to compete eagerly so as to gain something.
vine: noun. Any plant whose stem requires support and which climbs by tendrils or twining.
voe: noun. A narrow sea inlet, particularly in the Shetland Islands, similar to a fjord.
voice: noun. Sound uttered by the mouth, especially by human beings in speech or song; sound thus uttered considered as possessing some special quality or character.
ceo: noun. Alternative letter-case form of CEO.
cive: noun. Obsolete form of chive (“the herb”).
covine: noun. Alternative form of covin (“fraud, deception”).
eco: adjective. Clipping of ecological: environmentally friendly or sensitive.
nonic: adjective. Describing a polynomial that has 9 as the highest exponent of its terms.
novcic: noun. An old coin of Montenegro, worth one hundredth of a florin.
oenin: noun. An anthocyanin, the 3- glucoside of malvidin and the red pigment in red wine.
oni: noun. A Japanese evil spirit or demon.
